stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 4841 equates quasi-affineness of X with ampleness of the STRUCTURE sheaf O_X. The two-way condition is preserved.
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme.
Then $X$ is quasi-affine if and only if $\mathcal{O}_X$ is ample.
conclusions: $X$ is quasi-affine if and only if $\mathcal{O}_X$ is ample.

stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 4869 assumes X quasi-affine and i:X'→X a QUASI-COMPACT immersion, concluding X' quasi-affine. The draft retains quasi-compactness of i, not of X.
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-affine scheme. For any quasi-compact immersion
$i : X' \to X$ the scheme $X'$ is quasi-affine.
conclusions:
For any quasi-compact immersion
$i : X' \to X$ the scheme $X'$ is quasi-affine.

stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 4885 assumes a FINITE set of global functions whose principal opens are affine AND whose ideal generates all global functions, concluding X affine. Both covering-via-unit-ideal and affineness conditions are kept.
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme. Suppose that there exist finitely many elements
$f_1, \ldots, f_n \in \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item each $X_{f_i}$ is an affine open of $X$, and
\item the ideal generated by $f_1, \ldots, f_n$ in
$\Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ is equal to the unit ideal.
\end{enumerate}
Then $X$ is affine.
